run_fuse_gmock_cli: run the fuse_gmock_files.py script to fuse Google Mock and Google Test source files into a single output directory
build_fused_gmock_headers: build fused gmock/gmock.h and gtest/gtest.h header files from a Google Mock root directory using FuseGMock
build_fused_gmock_gtest_cc: build a combined gmock-gtest-all.cc source file that fuses all Google Mock and Google Test source code together
validate_gmock_root_dir: validate that a given path points to a valid Google Mock root directory with required seed files
summarize_fuse_gmock_functions: summarize the FuseGMockH, FuseGMockAllCcToFile, and FuseGMockGTestAllCc functions that recursively process and fuse header and source files
